say:1:1320820001:1.source_cn: 呼金，所有材料都集齐了！

say:2:1320820002:1.text: Nice! The exhaust valve was loosened, so the furnace should be able to hold out for a bit.
say:2:1320820002:1.source_cn: 好，我临走前让技工拧松了排气阀，熔炉应该可以撑一阵！

say:3:1320820003:1.text: That technician was still adding ore even after the pipe was clogged. Does he care that much about the official procedures?
say:3:1320820003:1.source_cn: 明明管道都堵塞了但还在按既定流程添加原材料，那位技工未...

say:4:1320820004:1.text: Hmph! One must abide by the rules and be adaptable at the same time. That's what makes a great craftsman! That boy is still too young.
say:4:1320820004:1.source_cn: 哼，既要恪守规则，又要学会灵活变通，这才是值得信赖的工...

say:5:1320820005:1.text: Now that all the ingredients are here, Magister, please mix them according to the recipe.
say:5:1320820005:1.source_cn: 既然材料集齐了——嚯嚯，魔法师大人，拜托你按配方把润滑...
say:5:1320820005:1.male: Now that all the ingredients are here, Magister, please mix them according to the recipe.
say:5:1320820005:1.female: Now that all the ingredients are here, Magister, please mix them according to the recipe.

document:7:112:0.text:
No one understands why these ingredients work as a lubricant, but oddly, when you combine oils from <style="highlight">snowgem berries</style>, <style="highlight">firethorn fruit</style> skin extract, and <style="highlight">bird saliva</style> heated to high temperatures, then add a touch of magic, it creates a slightly warm lubricant.

Hold it carefully in your hands, or it's going to slip right out.
document:7:112:0.source_cn:
……谁也不知道这些东西为什么能做成润滑剂，但奇怪的是，<style="highlight">莹霜醋栗</style>榨出的油脂、<style="highlight">血剑果</style>的表皮提取物和<style="highlight">野生鹫鸟的唾液</style>高温萃取，再混入一点魔法，就能做出微微发热的润滑剂。

要小心拿住，别让它从手中滑走！
